title: O Most Holy Trinity, I Adore You
text:
O most Holy Trinity,
I adore you
who dwell by your grace in my soul.
Sanctify me more and more,
make me love you more and more,
abide with me evermore
and be my true joy.
Amen
notes: App-1 title was 'O Sanctissima' but the text is this Trinity prayer; renamed to avoid clashing with the Marian hymn. Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
